stories.title: Juno Positions Itself As A Better-For-You Soda Without the Wellness Anxiety
stories.lede: Juno Soda’s packaging by Saint-Urbain is one of the most visually exciting things to hit the beverage aisle in years, pairing oversized retro typography, vibrant fruit-coded color, and mid-century soda fountain script with a prebiotic ingredient story that proves Barcelona’s answer to functional drinks looks a lot more like a vintage graphic design poster than a wellness product.
